shared_elements: repeated schematic feather/ray lines radiating from a center
justification: Both surfaces present a bilaterally symmetrical composition with spread wing-like forms and a prominent disc, and both use repeated schematic linear striations (feathers in A, rays in B), but these are generic devices. A is a single isolated hybrid bird-creature with a raptor head, talon-hands and layered scalloped feathering, while B is a narrative scene of standing human figures with elongated bodies offering before a laden altar under a rayed disc, accompanied by dense registers of script signs; no specific motif, relationship or arrangement is shared.
